entries.title: aggregate — groupBy + _count + avg
entries.sql: SELECT active AS active, count() AS _count, math::mean(age) AS avgAge FROM user GROUP BY active;
entries.note: SurrealDB requires every groupBy key in the projection, so `active: "active"` is explicit.

entries.sql: SELECT name, id AS _keyset_0 FROM user WHERE (id > $c0) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT $p0;
entries.note: The probe fetches limit+1 rows; `name` is the only selected column, so `id` rides along as the reserved `_keyset_0` alias — read for the cursor, stripped from `data`.

entries.title: create — CONTENT payload (default ULID id, generated server-side)
create — string id targets CREATE ONLY t:id
createMany — batched creates
create — idStrategy('uuid') generates a UUID v7 server-side
entries.note: `.idStrategy('uuid')` — no DDL, ORM-only; raw SQL keeps the server default.

entries.title: create — idStrategy('rand') keeps the server default (rand::id())
upsert — generated id resolves the unique row, else creates (onMissing create)
entries.sql: UPSERT ((SELECT VALUE id FROM uuid_user WHERE email = $p0 LIMIT 1)[0] ?? type::record(s"uuid_user", rand::uuid())) MERGE $p1;
entries.note: One statement: the subquery finds the existing row by UNIQUE, `??` falls back to the generated target.

entries.title: insert — onDuplicate ignore
update — set mode with an expression
upsert — STRICT update over id (the default; a miss rejects ResultNotFound)
upsert — insert-or-update over id (onMissing create)
upsert — no target is a plain CREATE (idStrategy id)
entries.note: With neither `where` nor `data.id` the call is a plain create — the id comes from the table's `idStrategy`.

entries.title: upsert — data.id infers the STRICT id target
entries.note: `where` omitted: the payload `id` names the record and matches the MERGE target; a miss still rejects `ResultNotFound`.

entries.title: upsertDelta — create-or-update with the before/after envelope (onMissing create)
entries.sql: UPSERT user:aeon MERGE $p0 RETURN VALUE { before: $before, after: $after };
entries.note: ONE statement: `$before`/`$after` come from the same UPSERT, decoded into `record`/`before`/`delta`.

entries.title: upsertDelta — STRICT update never creates (the default)
entries.sql: UPDATE ONLY user:aeon MERGE $p0 RETURN VALUE { before: $before, after: $after };
entries.note: `onMissing: 'throw'` (the default) compiles `UPDATE ONLY`; a miss rejects `ResultNotFound`.

entries.title: upsertDelta — distinct create/update payloads (onMissing create)
entries.code:
(client) =>
        client.users.upsertDelta({
          where: { id: "user:aeon" },
          create: {
            id: "user:aeon",
            name: "A",
            email: "a@x",
            age: 30,
            active: true,
            tags: [],
            address: { city: "SP" },
          },
          update: { age: 31 },
          onMissing: "create",
        })
entries.note: Distinct branches branch first (LET/IF) and envelope EACH branch in one transactional round-trip.
